name: com.placefitapp/placefit
title: PlaceFit
description: UK place evidence, letter grades and comparisons from official sources.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find UK places and postcodes in PlaceFit. Returns up to 8 results with id, title and canonical PlaceFit URL. Compatible with ChatGPT Deep Research and Company Knowledge.

query.description: A UK place name, postcode or outcode to search for.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the cited PlaceFit profile for an id from search, such as "area:southwell" or "postcode:NG25 0EH". Also accepts a plain area slug. Compatible with ChatGPT Deep Research and Company Knowledge.

id.description: A PlaceFit id such as "area:southwell" or "postcode:NG25 0EH", or a plain area slug.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search PlaceFit's directory, London boroughs and postcodes.io (places, postcodes and outcodes), ranked the same way as the PlaceFit website.

query.description: A UK place name, postcode or outcode.

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 15. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: get_place_profile
tools.description: Resolve a UK place, slug or postcode, load its cached PlaceFit snapshot, apply honesty guards, and return the deterministic letter grade (or an explicit coverage gap), cited measures, unscored context, gaps and attributions.

place.description: A PlaceFit slug, UK place name, or UK postcode.

preset.description: A PlaceFit starting-point preset. family, first_time_buyer, renter, commuter and retiring are for people moving home; landlord is for letting a property out.

school_phase.description: Which mainstream schools count in the schools score. Special and other non-mainstream schools never count.

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Compare two to four UK places with the same weights and directions. Returns ranked grades, category-by-category figures and winners, trade-offs, optional peak drive times, gaps and attributions.

places.description: Two to four UK places, slugs or postcodes to compare.

preset.description: A PlaceFit starting-point preset. family, first_time_buyer, renter, commuter and retiring are for people moving home; landlord is for letting a property out.

weights.description: Optional slider weights, 0 to 6. Measures at 0 drop out of the score.

directions.description: Optional lean for two-way measures such as heritage or hospitality. Unset two-way measures stay as context and are not scored.

commute_to.description: Optional destination (place name or postcode) for peak drive times.

school_phase.description: Which mainstream schools count in the schools score. Special and other non-mainstream schools never count.

tools.name: find_places_matching_brief
tools.description: Rank up to 10 English cities, towns, suburbs or villages from PlaceFit's national index for a brief. Wales and Scotland are not in the index. Full national lists stay behind the PlaceFit Pass.

preset.description: A PlaceFit starting-point preset. family, first_time_buyer, renter, commuter and retiring are for people moving home; landlord is for letting a property out.

priorities.description: Optional theme priorities. Higher numbers count more when ranking the England places index.

region_or_county.description: Optional English region, county or council name to restrict the list.

settlement_types.description: Optional settlement types to keep: city, town, suburb or village.

near_place.description: Optional place name or postcode to search near.

max_distance_km.description: Maximum straight-line kilometres from near_place, from 1 to 150.

limit.description: How many matches to return, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 10.
